slides.title: Busy Beavers Cohort Firewall
slides.notes: Pinned source; isolated tests and detailed limits in TESTS.md. No hosted demo or official score.

slides.title: 1 · The detector cannot return Blocked
slides.fix: Add explicit blocking conditions tied to the research question, measured effects and unresolved integrity failures.
slides.notes: The real analyze_releases engine returned Conditional for a synthetic 40-sample example whose A1 difference changed from +2.0 to −8.0. Both groups retained 20 samples. The change was detected and rerun, but the verdict never became Blocked.

slides.title: 2 · The unchanged-file shortcut lacks required-input validation
slides.fix: Check required-file presence, decodability and required columns before any equality shortcut.
slides.notes: The real analyze_releases engine returned Ready for two empty directories and again for two directories with identical zero-byte clinical.tsv and protein_rppa.tsv.gz. Both analyses were marked not_rerun with an identical-input explanation. The inspected reference-analysis Python module was present; it was not a missing-dependency failure.

slides.title: 3 · Easy export applies exclusion proposals without per-repair approval
slides.fix: Treat this as a clearly labelled unapproved preview, or require recorded review decisions before an approved repaired-data export.
slides.notes: The actual build_dataset easy route removed one synthetic record even though the supplied decision explicitly rejected its exclusion. Storage lookup was mocked; dataset construction and ZIP contents were real. The original four-row file was unchanged. This tests export semantics, not a deployed authorization bypass.

slides.title: 4 · Evidence and repair targets are truncated to 500
slides.fix: Keep a bounded display sample plus total count, truncation marker and complete separately addressable target set.
slides.notes: A synthetic 620-sample change produced a summary naming 620 affected samples but only 500 evidence entries and 500 unique repair targets. The truncation affects the machine-consumed repair set as well as display evidence.

slides.title: 5 · Free-text model context includes sample identifiers and evidence notes
slides.fix: Show the active provider and exact outbound categories before the first free-text request.
slides.notes: build_context retained a synthetic sample identifier and its synthetic evidence note. Known-ID validation rejected an invented citation and accepted a real fixture citation. No provider transport was called. This verifies payload construction and citation-ID checks, not a privacy breach or semantic factual correctness.

slides.title: 6 · Duplicate IDs are removed before their detector
slides.fix: Report duplicate IDs before deduplication, preserve both conflicting records and require an explicit record-selection policy.
slides.notes: A direct diff_file probe supplied a repeated synthetic identifier with an identical value and then a conflicting value of 99. Both produced no duplicate-ID event. The function removes duplicate indices before testing index.duplicated. This confirms the helper ordering defect; it is not evidence that every full application path silently accepts duplicates.

slides.title: 7 · Rounded hashes bypass the finer numerical tolerance
slides.fix: Use lossless screening before the declared tolerance, or document and consistently implement a deliberate quantization policy.
slides.notes: For values 1.00001 and 1.00004, rows_close returned False at its declared tolerance, but diff_file returned no change because their four-decimal profile hashes matched. Within-tolerance noise stayed quiet and a larger change was detected. In a full 40-sample engine fixture, the small above-tolerance change returned Ready, zero findings and analyses not_rerun. Scientific importance is task-specific; this is a disagreement between implemented equality policies, not a clinical-effect claim.

slides.title: What is verified so far
slides.fix: Read TESTS.md for skips, positive controls and limits.
slides.notes: 65 submitted tests passed. Thirteen local synthetic browser checks passed using actual Streamlit and FastAPI code; evidence, filtering, export and pending review observed. No hosted, clinical or full accessibility validation.
